description: Production TPC-DS SQL runs at SF!=1 use SF=1 dsqgen parameters because runner.get_queries (benchbox/core/tpcds/benchmark/runner.py:235) takes no scale, while runner.get_query renders at the data's scale. Callers: platforms/base/execution.py ~1033-1049, tpcds/power_test.py:217, tpcds/throughput_test.py:423 (whether query_kwargs carries a scale is unverified). Changing it alters the queries every SQL platform runs, so baselines and published comparability change. Produce an impact statement (which stored results and published comparisons use SF!=1 TPC-DS), then implement the owner's decision D1, or record 'no change' with reason.
